purpose: Evidence-backed prompt memory for recurrent asset-generation rejection patterns. Entries guide candidate generation only; they never auto-promote assets.

entries.prompt_hint: Keep one identical rust-orange safety hard hat, face, dark jacket and rust-orange accents across all OP animations.
Exactly one worker only; never show a companion, duplicate, reflection or second body.
Use stylized painterly 2.5D mobile game art, not a photograph or cinematic portrait.
Force structural silhouette changes early; never represent tier progression by scaling the same circular mass.
Facility architecture must dominate the silhouette; avoid a broad square perimeter deck or site-card base.
